title: Alarm
description: A clock alarm — a recurring wake or reminder trigger at a wall-clock time. In practice a daily-recurring iCalendar Vevent carrying an embedded VALARM. RFC 5545 compatible.

summary.description: The alarm's label (e.g. "Wake up"). Optional — an alarm needs no name.

dtstart.description: First occurrence as RFC 5545 floating time — deliberately zoneless (not RFC 3339): the alarm fires at this wall-clock time in whatever timezone the device is in.

rrule.description: Recurrence rule (RFC 5545 RECUR). FREQ=DAILY for an everyday alarm; add BYDAY (e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR) for weekday schedules.

status.description: CONFIRMED = enabled, CANCELLED = disabled. Calendars that hide CANCELLED events render a disabled alarm correctly.

valarm.description: Embedded iCalendar VALARM — the RFC 5545 alarm subcomponent that marks this event as one that rings.

trigger.description: When the alarm fires relative to dtstart (xsd:duration, e.g. PT0S for at-time).
